explanation: Lord Canning served as Governor-General during the Revolt of 1857 and became the first Viceroy of India in 1858.
Lothal (Gujarat), Kalibangan (Rajasthan), and Rakhigarhi (Haryana) are in India. Mohenjo-daro is in Pakistan.
Mahatma Gandhi returned to India on January 9, 1915, which is celebrated as Pravasi Bharatiya Divas.
